name: Kirino Ririka
source:
[i]“The City-Crazed Tsundere”[/i]

She is completely fed up with life in the boring countryside.

She constantly researches romance and femininity to show off and assert superiority over her friends... but in reality, she’s just an inexperienced know-it-all.

Though she acts tough and pretends to be a master of romance, she’s ultimately no different from the other two—just an innocent country girl at heart.

[b][i]“Guess I’ll lend you a hand again. So? Which girl are you aiming for?”[/i]
